title: Perfect constant models for stratified finite-field etale complexes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $k$ be a finite field. Let $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},k)$ be a bounded complex in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf $k_X$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose every cohomology sheaf is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. There is a finite stratification of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset] such that on an etale covering of each stratum $S$, $L|_S$ is isomorphic to the constant sheaf complex of a bounded complex of finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces; in particular the constant complex is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. After pro-etale comparison these are also the models of $(\nu_X^*L)|_S$, using [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. No integral lifting or completeness hypothesis is involved.

proof.text: Choose the cohomological bounds a <= b from hbounded. For the finite set Finset.Icc a b, use commonStratification, a finite-set induction: choose a constructibility stratification in the empty case, and at an insertion intersect the previous stratification with the one for the new degree using Stratification.inter. Convert finite-value constructibility to the source finite-locally-constant predicate by isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf. Each intersection refines both factors, so Stratification.Refines.isFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf_upperStar retains all previous degrees and the new one. Keep the actual fibre-product domains of Stratification.inter.

On a stratum put F = Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat k) immersion and K = F.mapDerivedCategory.obj L. The exact upperStar API identifies homology with F applied to homology, by mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, and carries zero homology outside [a,b] to zero. Inside [a,b] the common-stratification property supplies finite local constancy; outside use IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.of_isZero. For every etale object V, pull this finite locally constant sheaf to V and use finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to obtain a finite-value trivializing cover. Compose its members with V -> S, lift the cover index to Type (u+1), and use the jointly-surjective characterization of covering sieves. The slice/small-site equivalences, their constantSheafSheafCongrIso and upperStarComp transport each constant-value isomorphism to the required localized S-site. This is finiteLocalModels; it uses actual morphisms, including on empty schemes.

Apply etale_site_bounded_constant_models on each stratum to K, a, b, their order, the transported vanishing, and finiteLocalModels for each q and V. It returns an etale cover and actual cochain complexes P of finite k-modules, with zero terms outside [a,b], and derived constant-complex models for the successive inverse images. The derived upperStarComp isomorphism and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso identify the successive inverse image with inverse image along the composite cover-member/stratum morphism.

Convert the zero-term assertions to P.IsStrictlyGE a and P.IsStrictlyLE b with the corresponding iff lemmas. Each finite underlying module is Module.Finite by Module.Finite.of_finite, and every vector space is free and projective. Thus P itself, the same bounds, these termwise properties and Iso.refl witness IsPerfectRingComplex of Q.obj P, with the standard localization universe explicitly retained.

For h the composite cover-member/stratum morphism, cancel finiteCoefficientRealization followed by its inverse by the equivalence unit. Whisker comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso with the realization functor. This gives coefficientComparisonPullbackIso, an isomorphism finiteCoefficientComparison X k followed by finiteCoefficientPullback X k h with Etale.upperStar h followed by finiteCoefficientComparison U k. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and the two mapDerivedCategoryCompIso maps to obtain derivedCoefficientComparisonPullbackIso. These are the existing exact fixed-ring inverse images and the recorded coefficient realization, not a newly chosen ringed inverse image.

Apply finiteCoefficientDerivedComparison on U to the etale derived-model isomorphism. Factor it through comparisonUpperStar and finiteCoefficientRealization by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The exact comparison mapDerivedCategoryFactors identifies its value on Q of the constant complex with Q of the termwise comparison. Apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso to the existing natural comparisonUpperStarConstantSheafIso; its naturality in every k-linear differential supplies an isomorphism of actual complexes with the same P on the pro-etale site. Finally apply Q and the realization. Composing with step 5 proves the second Nonempty clause while retaining P and the cover from step 3. No pro-etale-cover conversion is required because the conclusion records an etale cover.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NV-ecc738d39 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 15 cited node statements, the parent integral-stratified characterization, the unit sk-thm-properbasechange, Stacks 094G (statement and full induction proof) and Bhatt–Scholze Prop. 6.6.11 (forward direction) and 6.8.11(3). The delivery is a first split with no new nodes, the statement is unchanged, review_split passes on the snapshot, and no SGA source is cited. Steps: (1) bounded interval, one constructibility stratification per degree, then repeated lem-weil-pbc-constructible-stratification-intersection, which uses real fibre-product schemes and constructible intersections. (2) Exactness from prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact(3) gives H^q(i^{-1}L)=i^{-1}H^q(L). The étale trivializing covers are pulled back along the refinement projections, and lem-sfb-geometric-inverse-image-constant-module keeps them constant with finite values on every étale W→S. (3) lem-weil-pbc-etale-site-bounded-constant-models (B=k finite commutative, a≤b) gives actual constant complexes of finite modules; Stacks 094G builds constant differentials. (4) Each term is projective by the Mathlib leaf and the complex is bounded, so it is perfect by def-pc-perfect-ring-complex; no claim is made over Z/4. (5) lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback, made termwise and derived by lem-pe exactness; the coefficient ring Cont(π0,Λ)^# is identified with the constant ring by prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map, so the coefficient category does not change silently. (6) Naturality in lem-sfb gives an isomorphism of complexes, and étale covers are pro-étale covers (098B leaf). Edge cases checked: empty X and empty strata, L=0, a=b, the residue characteristic of X equal to char k, and non-split extensions. The statement is true and needs no ℓ-invertibility. Accepted tool uses: lem-sfb-geometric-inverse-image-constant-module and lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image, both generic topos facts used only for coefficients. The lem-pur-etale-proetale-cover declaration is redundant because that node is a Mathlib leaf. Duplicate search: lem-fin-lisse-field-site-perfect (F_ℓ only, no stratification), lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-derived-local-constancy (local-constancy ingredient only) and lem-sf-etale-smooth-stratified-ctf (different hypotheses) are not duplicates. No fixes.
